classification.label: HS CODE
classification.guidance: No Postmall item codebook is embedded. Do not reuse Jimpass or Hoottown list IDs. Missing codes are draft values; the template does not explicitly state that HS may be omitted.

requiredFields.note: Headers have no required-star markers. Only the report-type and tracking comments explicitly allow blanks; absence of a marker does not prove that other inputs are optional.

upstreamSelections.note: Country, center, currency and carrier are not columns in this workbook. Confirm them in the Postmall application interface.

notes: ORDER_NO is described as the purchasing-agent business order reference, not the carrier tracking number.
G contains the complete recipient address; F is a separate postal code.
P is an A/B/C packing mode despite the technical key BOX_REMOVAL; do not write Y/N.
Do not import institution-specific Jimpass or Hoottown category IDs into ITEM_HS_CD.
The sanitized copy has all input/example values removed from row4 onward. Header styles and comments are preserved.
